For over 90 years, our family business has driven innovation and progress across industries, with operations spanning across 20+ countries. With a portfolio spanning across Automotive, Retail, Real Estate, Health, Finance and Education, our 40,000+ colleagues are dedicated to enriching the lives of our customers. We deliver the highest quality products and services for today, and for tomorrow. Our Philosophy Vision We provide quality products and services that enrich people’s lives and aspirations each and every day. Purpose We relentlessly pursue excellence to be the foremost provider of quality products and services, placing our customer needs at the heart of everything we do. Our Values Our values are the foundation of everything we do, driving us to create positive change and lasting impact. They inspire us to act with purpose, build trust, and deliver meaningful experiences for all. Respect The beating heart of our culture. It’s how we show up for our stakeholders, colleagues, customers, tradition, and environment. We recognise that ideas can come from anywhere. Excellence We are committed to quality. This is our benchmark for everything we do, in every corner of the company. Collaboration We build trusted partnerships to succeed. We keep our shared goals at the forefront and work together to successfully achieve them. Integrity We always do the right thing. This is one of our main motivators in upholding our company’s standards. Our History Our story began decades ago, rooted in ambition and progress, and we’re just getting started on an even brighter future. 2025-2021 2020–2011 2010–2001 2000–1986 1985-1971 1970-1930 2025 2025 Acquisition of Cenomi Retail Al-Futtaim acquires 49.95% of Cenomi Retail , a leading franchise retailer in Saudi Arabia. 2024 2024 Launch of BYD in Saudi Al-Futtaim Electric Mobility Company launches BYD in KSA . 2022 2022 Focus on Sustainable Mobility Al-Futtaim Automotive represents Polestar in the UAE. 2020 2020 New Brands Al-Futtaim Retail brings popular Asian multi-brand beauty store Watsons to the UAE market. 2019 2019 New Divisions, New Horizons Dubai Festival Plaza Mall opens its doors in Dubai . Al Futtaim Education Foundation and Al-Futtaim Health begin operations in the UAE . 2013 2013 Big Year of Expansion Cairo Festival City officially opens its door. DC Aviation Al-Futtaim is created in the UAE as a joint venture between Al-Futtaim and Stuttgart based DC Aviation GmbH. Al-Futtaim Leasing is established in the UAE . Al-Futtaim Vehicle Rentals opens in Qatar . IKEA opens at Doha Festival City, Qatar . 2008 2008 Grand Opening Al-Futtaim Real Estate with the completion of Dubai Festival City launch various business, lifestyle and entertainment venues. Contact a Healthcare Specialist Home Health Care Hospice Care In The Moments That Matter Most, You Are Not Alone Home health care helps people remain safely at home and live as independently as possible during recovery from a surgery, injury or illness, managing a serious or chronic disease or dealing with multiple diagnoses. We give you the tools and resources to help control your disease, achieve your health goals, and live life to its fullest. Based on your doctor's orders and your clinical needs, our care team comes to your home to provide health care services such as skilled nursing, home health aides, and physical, occupational or other therapies. Through working with you and your doctors, we develop a plan for you to manage medications and teach you about your condition. Our team helps you understand the expected course of your illness and watch for warning signs, and we work with your doctor to treat problems before they turn into something serious. Connect with Our Home Healthcare Team Today Hospice care is supportive care for families — not just the person facing the end of life. When a loved one has six months or less to live, they can receive compassionate care from a hospice team with the goal of maintaining comfort and quality of life. As the caregiver, you receive the peace of mind of knowing your loved one is receiving a care program tailored to their needs. At Amedisys, we know that every day of life matters, and we view hospice as a means for allowing people to make the very most of their time, even when faced with life-limiting circumstances. We care for our patients, working to help them achieve personal goals and to bring joy, comfort and fulfillment into every moment possible while also serving as a strong support system to their families. Nyheter och revidering av sortimentet På Apotek Hjärtat omvärderar vi kontinuerligt vårt sortiment utifrån våra kunders behov och är intresserade av nyheter som kan bidra till att öka kundnyttan. Revidering i butik sker tre gånger per år i maj, oktober och februari. Sortimentet online revideras löpande under året. Observera att solartiklar hanteras i februarirevideringen och julartiklar i oktoberrevideringen. Information för leverantörer som aviserar produkter under våren 2026 till Apotek Hjärtat Apotek Hjärtat genomför just nu en större satsning på att modernisera och kvalitetssäkra vår hantering av artikelinformation. Som en del av det utvecklar vi processen för hur artikelinformation skickas in. Målet är att stärka datakvaliteten och samtidigt lägga grunden för ett mer modernt sätt att avisera produkter. Hög datakvalitet kan vi bara uppnå tillsammans med er som leverantör. Er korrekta och uppdaterade artikelinformation är avgörande för att vi ska möta ökade krav från myndigheter, kunder och våra egna datadrivna satsningar. Vi inleder arbetet genom att införa nya artikeldatamallar anpassade per produkttyp inför kommande revideringar. Nya artikeldatamallar Oktoberrevidering 2026 De nya mallarna ersätter Apotek Hjärtats tidigare generella mall och bygger på en strukturerad datamodell. Detta är ett viktigt steg mot Apotek Hjärtats framtida artikelportal som kommer att digitalisera artikelavisering till oss. Mallarna är centrala för att: Stärka kvaliteten på artikelinformation. Minska behovet av kompletteringar. Förbereda övergången till artikelportalen. Gällande datum för kommande revidering Oktoberrevidering Butik 2026 Avisering ska ske via de nya artikeldatamallarna per produkttyp. Vänligen märk ditt inskick med respektive produktkategori. Deadline för avisering är 8 maj 2026 (vecka 19). Revidering i butik startar vecka 41, 2026. Endast artiklar som inkommit i tid och är kompletta kan hanteras i denna revidering. Onlinerevidering Avisering ska ske via de nya artikeldatamallarna per produkttyp från och med 31 mars 2026. Vänligen märk ditt inskick med respektive produktkategori. Avisering sker löpande under året. Vid frågor om hur du fyller i de nya artikeldatamallarna vänligen kontakta: masterdata.supplier@apotekhjartat.se Avisering och dokumentation till Apotek Hjärtat För att Apotek Hjärtat ska kunna utvärdera och ta in nya artiklar behöver vi för alla artiklar få in: Fullständig och korrekt ifylld artikeldatamall. Förpackningshierarki. Bilder för planogram och försäljning online. Säkerhetsdatablad för kemiska produkter samt för övriga produkter i de fall det är aktuellt utifrån transport och lagring. Övrig kvalitetsdokumentation utifrån produkttyp enligt nedan. Information gällande aviseringsdokument Artikeldatamall Döp filen enligt följande: Artikeldatamall_Leverantörsnamn_Varumärke_Revideringsfönster. Exempel: Artikeldatamall_Apotek Hjärtat _Apolosophy_Oktober 2026.xlsx Förpackningshierarki Döp filen enligt följande: Förpackningshierarki_Leverantörsnamn_Varumärke_Revideringsfönster. FAQs See more FAQs How do I transfer to another registrar such as GoDaddy? Yes, you can transfer your domain to any registrar or hosting company once you have purchased it. Since domain transfers are a manual process, it can take up to 5 days to transfer the domain. Domains purchased with payment plans are not eligible to transfer until all payments have been made. Please remember that our 30-day money back guarantee is void once a domain has been transferred. For transfer instructions to GoDaddy, please click here . How do I get the domain after the purchase? Once you purchase the domain we will push it into an account for you at our registrar, NameBright.com, we will then send you an email with your NameBright username and password. In most cases access to the domain will be available within one to two hours of purchase, however access to domains purchased after business hours will be available within the next business day. What comes with the domain name? Nothing else is included with the purchase of the domain name. Our registrar NameBright.com does offer email packages for a yearly fee, however you will need to find hosting and web design services on your own. Do you offer payment plans? Yes we offer payment plans for up to 12 months. See details . How do I keep my personal information private? If you wish the domain ownership information to be private, add WhoIs Privacy Protection to your domain. This hides your personal information

View Products Request a Demo Meet our Team INNOVATIONS FOR SIMPLIFYING PULMONARY CARE Global Epidemic of Chronic Respiratory Diseases At Cognita Labs, we’re transforming pulmonary care. We tackle the global challenge of chronic respiratory diseases head-on, delivering cutting-edge, research-backed solutions that seamlessly bridge in-clinic treatment with vital remote monitoring. We are at the forefront of innovation, dedicated to shaping a healthier future for respiratory patients worldwide. Our mission is to simplify and elevate respiratory care. Through advanced technology, we empower earlier detection, precise diagnosis, and seamless patient management, both in-clinic and remotely. We strive to make high-quality respiratory care accessible, affordable, and seamless across all settings. Spirometry is not enough Spirometry is the workhorse of pulmonary lung function testing, and can provide significant information about patient’s lung function. Spirometry is an established method to detect both obstructive and restrictive respiratory illnesses. However, spirometers have not seen much use outside the PFT lab due to the fact that commercial spirometers are designed to work in clinical environments, to be operated by well-trained technicians. As a result, spirometry remains generally limited to larger hospitals and dedicated Pulmonary Function Testing (PFT) labs. PulmoScan - Quick, Effort-Free Airway Impedance Testing Cognita Labs has developed PulmoScan, a next generation of smart portable airway assessment device, with an assistive coaching tablet application and a cloud support. PulmoScan’s innovative zero-effort quick test makes it possible to integrate respiratory testing with on the go workflows such as high volume clinics, pediatric offices where quality spirometry is often difficult. PulmoScan is a Class II FDA cleared device and was developed from ground-up to allow minimally trained medical professionals to conduct accurate lung assessment. Click here for more information. Learn more about PulmoScan CapMedic - Most Comprehensive Solution for Correct Inhaler Use and Home Spirometry We have developed world’s first inhaler attachment for MDI, that can measure inhaler use with high granularity. Cognita’s CapMedic provides real-time audio-visual interactive guidance on correct use of inhalers and also measure correctness of inhaler use, time and frequency of its use. CapMedic is also a home spirometer, measures FEV1 and PEF. CapMedic is a Class II FDA cleared device. Please visit the website for more information. Learn more about CapMedic UltraSpiro - Interactive Coaching Spirometer UltraSpiro is the world’s first intelligent coaching spirometer with the highest flow sensitivity in the market with 1% error-rates. The connected spirometer communicates with state of the art mobile app and cloud platform Designed to be mobile, data-driven and interactive for improved patient engagement. Integrated Innovation Through integrated innovation, our mobile, data-driven, and interactive solutions deliver full-spectrum care that truly bridges the gap between clinics and patients. We are deeply committed to making high-quality lung care accessible, affordable, and seamless across all settings, with a particular focus on underserved populations and practical, impactful solutions that make a real difference. Enables remote patient monitoring Securely share data with your physician about medication use and lung health. Providers can now make data-driven decisions with complete medication and lung function history, even remotely. Reimbursable under the new CMS telehealth policy. Our people proposition Nurturing and growing talent Careers at Imperial Imperial Health Sciences Home | General terms | Imperial Health Sciences Imperial is a leading force in African healthcare supply chain management. Our extensive network across the continent, coupled with our experience in all channels of the medical supply chain, means that we can offer our clients the trust and confidence that is key in the healthcare sector. The Health Sciences business unit of Imperial in South Africa provides distribution solutions for clients across South Africa. In addition, it integrates tightly with the healthcare value added logistics and supply chain solutions offerings of the Managed Solutions business unit in the markets outside of South Africa and provides supply support into the Route-to-Market businesses of Imperial across Sub-Saharan Africa. History The Health Sciences business unit of Imperial in South Africa was established in 2000 as PHD. The company was bought by RTT, which changed its name to RTT Medical. Imperial acquired RTT Medical in January 2013 and renamed the business as Imperial Health Sciences (IHS). Core business Imperial is Africa s leading partner in the healthcare supply chain. Our common purpose is to ensure the secure and sustainable supply of quality medicines to the people of Africa. Imperial Health Sciences operations are ISO9001:2015 certified for the receipt, storage and distribution of pharmaceuticals and other healthcare products. We provide warehousing and distribution services for over 33 multinational and South African manufacturers and deliver to more than six thousand hospitals, clinics, pharmacies, doctors, wholesalers and health stores. We process and deliver up to four thousand orders each day for customers in South Africa and almost two thousand export orders per month servicing export markets across Africa. Service offering Warehousing and storage Cold storage and cold chain delivery Distribution We cater to the full spectrum of the healthcare market such as medical practitioners, hospitals, clinics, pharmacies, health shops, wholesalers and retailers. Innovation We are dedicated to developing advanced medical devices that bring about a revolution in patient care. Our focus on safety and effectiveness is coupled with an ergonomic design to ensure that our products not only meet but exceed clinical expectations. Quality Our products are the result of extensive research and close collaboration with healthcare professionals. We believe in combining practical insights from the medical field with our innovative approach to address real-world clinical challenges effectively. Education We strive to make advanced medical care accessible to people around the globe. This goal is supported by our initiatives to provide comprehensive educational resources and support to healthcare providers, enhancing the overall quality of care delivered. TEstimonials Our partners in health: collaborating for medical excellence “The Capnomask™ has a superior attachment of the O₂ tubing to the mask and the mask quality is also superior and offers a great fit. I prefer it to any other mask on the market.” Dr Emad Aziz, Guy’s and St Thomas’ NHS Foundation Trust “I’m delighted with the S-Cath™ suprapubic catheter. Seit 1988 Angebot anfordern Produktsortiment 38 Jahre Erfahrung auf dem globalen Gesundheitsmarkt. Kontrolle über alle Stufen der Lieferkette. Maßgeschneiderte Lösungen für die spezifischen Bedürfnisse von Fachkräften im Gesundheitswesen. Expertise Einblick in den Sektor Rechtliche Kenntnisse Strategische Leitlinien Dienstleistungen Schnelle Unterstützung Individuelle Betreuung Kontinuierliche Weiterentwicklung Logistik Effiziente Verteilung Lagerkapazitäten Lokales Bestandsmanagement seit 1988 Leidenschaft für Gesundheit Meditrade verbindet die internationale Stärke eines global tätigen Unternehmens mit den Werten eines familiengeführten Betriebs und bietet umfassende Lösungen für das Gesundheitswesen. Wir nutzen über 38 Jahre Branchenerfahrung in ganz Europa, um medizinisches Fachpersonal dabei zu unterstützen, jeden Tag eine außergewöhnliche Patientenversorgung zu leisten. Healthcare and homecare partner | Mediq About Our Story Our Approach Leadership Team Global Presence Corporate Governance Sustainability ESG Strategy ESG Reporting Stories Case Studies Products Services Products Services Careers Contact News At the heart of healthcare Mediq serves healthcare professionals and patients with medical devices, healthcare products and innovative solutions. We work with hospitals, healthcare facilities, GPs and nurses to ensure that they can provide best possible care. We also supply people with the daily support and care they need to successfully self-manage their chronic condition. Both in health-care settings and at home. Our Vision Enabling Sustainable Healthcare At Mediq, we are at the heart of healthcare, supporting delivery to patients' homes, practitioners, care institutions, and hospitals. We offer products, solutions, and services across major disease areas, driving innovative solutions to address healthcare’s biggest challenges. Fueled by our dedicated team, we optimize time and resources, making care more manageable for providers, efficient for payors, better for the environment, and ultimately better for patients and society. We call that Sustainable Care. Read more about us Our ESG Efforts We Care to Care At Mediq, responsible and ethical business practices are at the heart of everything we do, guiding our actions towards patients, employees, partners, suppliers, and investors. Mediq’s ESG (Environmental, Social, Governance) strategy is built on four key pillars: products, services, operations, and people. Our goal is to achieve carbon neutrality and create a lasting positive impact on our environment and communities by 2050. Explore our full ESG strategy here Providing empowerment, support and care A lot has happened since Mediq was founded in the Netherlands in 1899 as a cooperative of pharmacists. Our drive to help patients live higher quality lives is what has made our company the leading European healthcare provider it is today. To this end, we consistently invest in operational excellence as well as advanced digital technologies and innovative care delivery models. Always looking for new opportunities to make life and work easier and more enjoyable for people with healthcare needs and those who care for them. Read more about Mediq ESG stories Nutrition Denmark: A Case Study in Improving Healthcare Outcomes At Mediq, Corporate Social Responsibility (CSR) is embedded in everything we do. It impacts our stakeholders, patients, healthcare providers, insurers, vendors, and colleagues. In 2022, we made significant improvements in implementing our CSR strategy and strengthening our environmental and social impact. A virtual coach for everyday questions about incontinence care Research by Mediq produced interesting insights. People with urinary and bowel incontinence struggle with all kinds of problems which negatively impact their overall day to day life. ‘I'm ashamed that I wet myself,’ said 80-year-old Piet. And he's not the only one. Read more Supporting care professionals - logistic solution for nursing home The ordering and delivery process for incontinence pads and products can be quite a hassle for nursing home staff. ‘First and foremost, I want to help patients, without being involved in logistic-related things’, is what nurse Eveline told the regional manager at Mediq. Read more Read more stories Mediq is a major force in European Healthcare. We have a strong presence across 14 countries. We support every patient, every healthcare professional in all facets of healthcare in every country. The headquarter of Mediq is situated in the Netherlands. If you wish to read more about Global Presence, you can follow the link below. Read more about Global Presence Ready to shape tomorrow's healthcare? At Mediq, you will be part of a diverse culture that puts people first: our own people and our customers. An environment where you can grow professionally and personally. Where initiative is encouraged and appreciated. So, if you are just as passionate about healthcare and want to help shape its future to help patients, perhaps we should talk. To make this portfolio easier to navigate, Mediq is bringing these products together under a single label: Mediq Select. Our vision We enable sustainable care. Environmental Social Governance At Mediq, we are guided by strong moral and ethical standards in our interactions with customers, employees, and partners. We are at the heart of healthcare, and we leverage this unique position to collaborate closely with healthcare partners to accomplish sustainability transition in healthcare. As we grow, we remain committed to minimizing our environmental impact. Mediq s ESG strategy is built on four pillars: products, services, operations, and people. Our goal is carbon neutrality and a positive impact on our environment and communities by 2050, fully aligned with regulations like CSRD and CSDD, ensuring transparency and continuous improvement. Operations We minimize waste, packaging, transport emissions, and energy use in our buildings, guided by the principles of circularity. About us - PHOENIX group PHOENIX group PHOENIX in Europe Across Europe Our brands services About PHOENIX News About us Management History Sustainability Compliance Career Publications Investor Relations Sustainability report downloads Press Media library DE EN DE EN The PHOENIX group The PHOENIX group, headquartered in Mannheim, is the European leader in pharmaceutical wholesale, pharmacy retail, and services for the pharmaceutical industry. With a presence in 29 healthcare markets, the group of companies offers unique geographical coverage throughout Europe, making a vital contribution to comprehensive healthcare with over 48,000 employees. The PHOENIX group is active in the pharmaceutical wholesale and pre-wholesale business areas with 204 sites in 29 countries supplying pharmacies, doctors, and medical institutions with medicines and health products. Numerous other products and services for pharmacy customers complete the portfolio – from assistance in advising patients to modern goods management systems to pharmacy cooperation programmes. Over 18,000 pharmacies in 18 countries are members of one of the PHOENIX group’s cooperation and partnership programmes. The group of companies provides the pharmaceutical industry with Healthcare Logistics and other services along the entire supply chain. The PHOENIX group also operates over 3,200 of its own pharmacies in 15 European countries, in which around 186 million patients per year receive expert advice from pharmacists in addition to their medicines. PHOENIX in figures: 204 sites pharmaceutical wholesale/pre-wholesale in 29 countries 3200 own pharmacies in 15 countries 200 Manufacturers profit from the Pharma Services of the PHOENIX group 186 Mio. customers contacts in pharmacies every year 48000 employees 66.9 Billion Total Operating Performance in fiscal year 2025/26 OUR MISSION We deliver health. This has been the mission since the foundation of our company in 1994. It has guided us on our journey from a German pharmaceutical wholesaler to what we are today: Europe’s leading pharmaceutical wholesaler, pharmacy operator and service provider for the pharmaceutical industry. OUR VISION We are the partner of choice for simple and direct access to healthcare products and services across Europe. All our actions are guided by our customers’ needs. We develop and offer tailored products and services and make healthcare easily accessible. This is why our customers, no matter where they are located along the pharmaceutical supply chain, choose us. wePHOENIX WePHOENIX describes how we conduct our work. Since 2011, it has maintained its position as the biggest supplier of cardiovascular (CVS) pharmaceuticals in SA in terms of value and volume. Pharma Dynamics’ growing product portfolio spans a range of therapeutic areas. Headquartered in Cape Town, South Africa, the company also has a well-established footprint in Namibia, Botswana, Zambia, Zimbabwe, Mozambique, Angola and Kenya. Pharma Dynamics is a wholly owned subsidiary of the global pharmaceutical company, Lupin Limited. SOCIO ECONOMIC DEVELOPMENT We all have a role in shaping the world for the better. Our corporate social responsibility initiatives are centred on social economic development programmes in the areas of education and youth empowerment. We make a difference by supporting the following programmes. YES (Youth Employment Service) is a private sector-led youth employment programme that partners with businesses in various sectors to provide 12-month long, work experiences for unemployed youth to develop skills and gain work experience. For 2024, Pharma Dynamics has committed an initial R6 million towards the human capital investment that will give 88 entry-level graduates an opportunity to gain invaluable work experience as trainees in the company, which will provide a springboard to career advancement within the pharmaceutical and healthcare supply chains. MyDynamics serves as a trusted content hub where patients can access: Condition Support: In-depth content tailored to their medical condition. Daily Usage Tips If your KINGYIELD Blood Pressure Watch gets wet from hand washing, rain, or water-related activities, wipe it dry promptly and allow it to dry completely before measuring your blood pressure. Do not wear the watch in high-temperature or high-humidity environments, such as hot showers, hot springs, saunas, or steam rooms. 3. Do not wear the watch while swimming, snorkelling, diving, scuba diving, or during any other activity that involves prolonged immersion in water. 4. Do not wear the watch during activities involving high water pressure or fast-moving water, such as diving, water skiing, surfing or other motorised water sports, and rafting. User Guide 1. About TradeIndia.com - India's Largest Online B2B Marketplace About Success Story Careers Help Contact Us Sign In | Join Free #SabMilegaYahinMilega Making Indian MSMEs Digitally Saksham We are one of India’s largest and oldest B2B marketplace that connects buyers and suppliers to create a customer-driven value chain for all businesses, including SMEs, large enterprises, and individuals. We integrate businesses into global value chains by bringing them together from across the world, on a single platform to interact and conduct the business smoothly, securely, and effectively. 89 Million+ Inquiries Every Year 11.4 Million+ Registered Users 100,000+ Product Categories 20 Category Rank Our Mission and Vision Let’s enable 63 million+ SMEs to go digital With technology and innovation as enablers, we endeavour to help our users reinvent businesses to compete and win, with digitization at the core. We also pride ourselves to be the only marketplace offering 360° digital marketing solutions to MSMEs to help them be tech-enabled. With a robust pan- India as well as a global presence in 10+ countries, we also assist global buyers to locate Indian suppliers, manufacturers, and exporters. Meet Our Force Bikky Khosla Founder & Chairman Bikky Khosla is a first-generation entrepreneur who has revolutionised the dot-com industry with a vision to serve India’s trade community in 1990, which is TI today. He also serves as the chairman of ASSOCHAM's e-commerce committee. He is also the editor of SME Times and is well-versed in how investors should invest in early-stage companies. Sandip Chhettri Chief Executive Officer Sandip Chhettri is an MSME expert with over 20+ years of experience. Known as an innovator and visionary, he is an acknowledged leader in digital transformation and the force behind the success of TradeIndia. He has been recognised as an ‘Emerging Voice’ for his extensive writing on the recovery and survival of Indian MSMEs in a post-pandemic world. Zille Elahi Chief Revenue Officer Zille Elahi is a dynamic & seasoned business leader with over 2 decades of work experience in sales of products and services. He oversees the organisation's revenue and drives initiatives leading to revenue and is highly result oriented and a growth leader.He has also been instrumental in contributing to making a diverse and inclusive work culture at TradeIndia. Our Core Values Trust and Transparency At the heart of our organization, trust and transparency stand as unwavering core values. Trust is the foundation upon which all our relationships, both internal and external, are built. It's the bedrock of our commitment to integrity and accountability, as we believe that trust is not given but earned through consistent actions and open communication. Constant Learning We understand that in a rapidly evolving world, stagnation is not an option. We embrace the spirit of continuous improvement, encouraging every member of our team to seek knowledge, acquire new skills, and adapt to emerging trends and technologies. We view challenges as opportunities for growth and change as a chance to evolve and excel. Ownership Taking ownership is a fundamental core value that defines the essence of our organization. We believe that success is a product of personal responsibility and accountability. We encourage every member of our team to embrace challenges as opportunities to take ownership of their work, decisions, and outcomes. Drive and Deliver We believe that having the determination to push boundaries and the dedication to turn ambitions into reality are vital components of success. Every member of our team is driven by a relentless pursuit of our goals, fueled by a passion for innovation and a sense of purpose. One 'TI' A cohesive culture, uniting us under the banner of "One TI," is the heartbeat of our organization. We recognize that our strength lies not just in individual talents but in our collective spirit and shared values. We foster an environment where every member feels a sense of belonging and ownership, working collaboratively towards our common mission. 例）この想いを実現するために、 私たちは挑戦を続けます。 医療現場、地域、そしてすべての人の“健康”をつなぐ存在として、 既存の枠を越え、共に創り、共に支え合う社会を目指します。 それが、東邦ホールディングスの変わらない使命です。 詳しく見る --> Business 事業内容 東邦ホールディングスは、医薬品卸売事業、調剤薬局事業、医薬品製造販売事業などの各事業が密接に連携し、グループの総合力を活かして医療・健康・介護分野における様々な課題の解決に取り組んでいます。医療機関の良きパートナーとして現場を支え、患者さま一人ひとりに寄り添うことで、誰もが安心して質の高い医療を受けられる社会の実現を目指しています。 医薬品卸売事業 医薬品、検査薬、医療機器・医療材料、OTCなどの卸売事業を基盤に、医療機関の業務効率化に貢献する顧客支援システムの開発・提供、開業支援や院内物流支援（SPD）など、医療全般にわたるトータルサポートを展開しています。また、グループの総合力を活かして、地域の実情や課題を見極め、地域包括ケアシステムの構築に貢献しています。 詳しく見る 調剤薬局事業 Based in Tokyo and operating globally, Terumo employs more than 25,000 associates worldwide to provide innovative medical solutions in more than 160 countries. The company started as a Japanese thermometer manufacturer and has been supporting healthcare ever since. Now, its business portfolio ranges from vascular intervention and cardio-surgical solutions, blood transfusion, and cell therapy technology to medical products essential for daily clinical practice such as transfusion systems, diabetes care, and peritoneal dialysis treatments. Terumo will further strive to be of value to patients, medical professionals, and society at large. Business Overview Interventional Systems Minimally invasive medical devices for interventional cardiology, peripheral vascular, endovascular, and oncology. Cardiovascular Medical devices for cardiac and vascular surgery with an emphasis on cardiopulmonary bypass and intra-operative monitoring. Medical Care Solutions Medical devices used in various medical settings, including ICUs, general wards, operating rooms, and patients' homes. Cardiothoracic and Vascular Grafts Medical devices for the treatment of aortic and peripheral vascular disease using surgical and stent grafts. CoaChrom will become part of AddLife’s business area, Labtech, and will continue to operate under its own brand in line with AddLife’s decentralised business model. To BioSpectrum Our business areas MEDTECH In the Medtech business area, the subsidiaries offer products and services in medical technology, as well as assistive equipment and digital solutions for use in home care. Medtech has two business units - Hospital and Homecare. The Medtech offering mainly focuses on publicly funded healthcare, home care and social care in Europe. Read more LABTECH The Labtech business area provides products, solutions and services in fields such as diagnostics, biomedical research and laboratory analysis. The business area consists of two business units: Biomedical and Research and Diagnostics. The most important customer groups are hospital laboratories, academic research and pharmaceutical companies in Europe. Continue Shopping Checkout Now Our Story Hospitals Trust Defries We are committed to improving patient care with our single-use, sterile medical products and customised procedure packs. Read More Since 1980 The Defries Industries team share a vision of high standards and a commitment to superior patient care. We continually strive to create outstanding products that excel in design, ease of use, safety and price. 1980 Established in 1980 in Melbourne, Australia by the de Fries family, the company was founded as a medical manufacturing business. By incorporating a cleanroom, office and warehouse, Defries Industries started to offer the Australian healthcare sector innovative and unique medical products. 1990 By this stage Defries had increased its medical products to around 500 different types and also began to offer disposable single use instruments to various departments in hospitals. Defries started a successful distribution of products to New Zealand. 1995 Defries Industries continued to grow, supported by Australian hospitals wanting to buy locally. Custom procedure packs were designed to offer hospitals a time saving alternative to individual consumables. At this stage Defries Industries also expanded significantly to purchase a new automatic packaging machine to streamline manufacturing and two more factories. 2000 Defries Industries now has over 100 employees and designs and manufactures over 1,000 different product specialties, used by many hospitals departments including the Operating Theatre, Emergency department, Sterilising Units, Maternity Services and General wards. 2007 Expanded our company by two sites - a new head office and complete warehousing facility at 18-24 Villas Road Dandenong South and our manufacturing site at 17-19 22 Kempson Court, Keysborough, Melbourne, Australia. Defries Industries commences distributing DeRoyal products throughout Australia. 2011 Defries Industries was awarded DeRoyal “International Distributor of the Year” for Improving Care and Improving Business for 2010. This award was also won again in 2014. 2012 Over 3,000 product specialties and over 160 dedicated employees. Advancis Wound Care, a leading UK company product that includes the Manuka honey range of wound care, is now proudly distributed in Australia by Defries Industries. Defries produces over 6 million medical products per annum. 2015 Defries opened our new Head Office in Dandenong South and state-of-the-art cleanroom which more than doubled our manufacturing and processing capacity. This saw the consolidation of our Victorian sites to three sizeable locations in Dandenong South, Melbourne to provide us with greater efficiencies and further opportunities for growth. Our Perth and Adelaide distribution warehouses also opened. 2019 New Sales and Marketing office and Raw Materials warehouse opened across from our Head Office. 2020+ Our commitment is to improve patient care by offering sterile medical products. We want to provide better care by offering health care professionals expertise in the Defries range of products. Our Team 180+ specially trained staff dedicated to product and service excellence. The Singapore team coordinates with all 9 other countries to ensure high-quality service delivery for both our business partners and customers. Meet Our Regional Team JAMES SIMKINS Chairman James Simkins has over 13 years of experience in various leadership positions in the Getz Group, with experience in Healthcare, Pharmaceuticals, Distribution and Retail. Before that, he worked for eight years in an investment bank in London. Born and raised in Asia, James has a BA (Honours) in Politics and East Asian Studies from the Newcastle University in the United Kingdom, with one year in Fukuoka University in Japan. PETER QUINLAN Chief Executive Officer Peter Quinlan has over 20 years of leadership experience in global healthcare and medical technology. He has lived and worked extensively across Europe and the Asia-Pacific region, including the Netherlands, New Zealand, and Singapore, developing a strong appreciation for the region’s diversity and growth potential. Peter began his career as a radiographer before joining Philips Healthcare, where he spent 16 years in senior roles spanning global product management, sales, marketing, and APAC market leadership. He later served as General Manager for Greater Asia at Baxter Healthcare, further strengthening his regional commercial and operational expertise. As CEO, Peter is recognised for his open and authentic leadership style, strong focus on execution, and commitment to developing local talent. His leadership is anchored on four core pillars: engaged teams, satisfied customers, delivery on commitments, and uncompromising ethics and compliance. JOE MITCHELL Chief Integration Officer Joe has over 25 years' experience in business transformation, mergers and acquisitions and developing change management strategies, in new and existing markets. Educated in the UK and Mexico, Joe has attained a double Master's in Business Administration (MBA) and Human Resource Management (MA). Other qualifications include certifications in Change Management (Prosci Practioner), Project Management (Prince 2) and Information Technology (ITIL V3). Born and raised in London UK. Joe spent a couple of years living and working in Hong Kong, before relocating to Singapore where he has been for the past 13 years. HAROON ASLAM Regional Finance Director Haroon Aslam has over 20 years of experience in blue chip companies within engineering, distribution, manufacturing medical industries. Haroon holds a Bachelor in Finance from the University of Western Sydney and is a qualified Certified Public Accountant. Born in Pakistan, Haroon is currently based in Singapore, having worked and lived in Australia, the Philippines, Malaysia, Thailand, China and Japan. Pioneer in the importation of medical materials, the Cirúrgica Fernandes sells products from more than 20 countries, counting on the exclusivity of brands from Europe, North America and Asia. The 25,000 m² distribution center, with more than 250 employees, 120 representations throughout the country and a mix of more than 9,000 products, reflects the union and sense of teamwork; an ethical and responsible work, symbol of the expansion that generates the continuous development of the company. History 1946 | The beginning: The history of Cirúrgica Fernandes merges with the history of one of its founders, Mr. Luiz Fernandes, a visionary, who began his activities as a salesman of hospital equipment in 1945. In the following year, in partnership with his cousin José Ganade Fernandes, he founded Cirúrgica Fernandes in a commercial room on Araújo Street, in the center of São Paulo. 1950s: The company expands its business and its headquarters starts to occupy a two-floors house in Asdrúbal do Nascimento Street, besides opening the doors for direct sale to the consumer and a second address in Benjamim Constant Street, both in the center of São Paulo. 1968 | Cirúrgica Fernandes in other hands: The exponential growth of Cirúrgica Fernandes starts to attract the interest of several international companies and the partners choose to sell the company to a Franco-Belgian multinational, a transaction that was concluded in 1972, with Cirúrgica Fernandes already then occupying a space of 1,000 m² in a new address in Clodomiro Amazonas Street, Itaim neighborhood, in São Paulo. 1978 | The take back: Under the management of the new owners the company does not achieve the success they longed for and is then offered to the former partners for repurchase. Mr. Luiz Fernandes is interested in reassuming the business and his son, Mr. Marcos Fernandes, recently graduated as a civil engineer, at his father’s request, becomes part of the company’s management. At this moment the company starts to occupy a new address, with a space of 1,500 m² in Borges Lagoa Street. 80’s: In the beginning of the 80’s a new store is opened for direct sale to the consumer in Napoleão de Barros Street, very close to the headquarters of Borges Lagoa Street. Dr. Luiz Antônio Fernandes, physician, son of Mr. Luiz Fernandes, at the invitation of his father, completes the board of directors of Cirúrgica Fernandes. 90’s: Expansion plan: From the 90’s on, the second generation of the family, the sons of Mr. Fernandes – Luiz Antonio and Marcos, take over the company’s management, leaving Mr. Luiz in the presidency. Due to the need for greater storage capacity, an 8,000 m² plot of land is acquired on Raposo Tavares Road, where a large distribution center is built. 2008: Cirúrgica Fernandes starts operating in its new distribution center in Tamboré, occupying an area of more than 25,000 m² and quickly reaching levels of excellence, being one of the first distributors of health products to be certified by Anvisa in 2009 . In this same period, Mr. Luiz Fernandes leaves the presidency, but remains as a board member in his sons’ administration. 2016: In the 70th anniversary of Cirúrgica Fernandes, its founder, Mr. Luiz Fernandes, passes away. The company maintains its strong growth and, in order to meet the needs arising from the continuous increase in its turnover, the duplication of its warehouse area is carried out. 2019: The distribution center of Cirúrgica Fernandes, goes through continuous processes of expansion to serve a growing number of customers, certified by Anvisa and qualification groups such as GAFO, ANHAP, Amil, Associação Portuguesa de Beneficência and many others. With quality products and high technology, allied to a logistic service of excellence, Cirúrgica Fernandes has been ahead of its time for more than seven decades. Mission, vision and values The constant search for excellence in service offering high quality services, with logistical agility, inherent to a branch of action whose purpose is the preservation of human life, are priorities for Cirúrgica Fernandes, as well as investment in infrastructure and modernization, resulting in exponential growth of our operations and the quality of our services. Mission: To seek the satisfaction of our customers providing products and services with excellence and high quality. Vision: To be a reference in q

Its aim is to offer French healthcare players innovative products with high added value. View more Ensure a successful market entry in France Our solutions All our solutions Ambulatory actimetry – Parkinson’s disease Parkinson’s disease is a neurodegenerative disorder characterized by the destruction of a specific population of neurons involved in movement control. At present, there is no cure for this disease, and treatment aims to control symptoms by optimizing medication plans. Optimizing and personalizing treatment currently relies on clinical interviews, diaries and scales, although in the future it could benefit from information on symptoms and compliance collected outside the clinic while patients carry out their normal daily activities. Our solution Nasal applicator – Primary and induced headaches Primary headaches Migraines with or without aura Tension headaches Post-traumatic stress headache Atypical facial pain Trigeminal neuralgia Headaches, characterized by recurrent headaches, are one of the most widespread disorders of the nervous system. It is generally estimated that almost half the adult population has had at least one headache in the past year. Headaches are associated with a burden on the individual and society, in the form of pain, disability and deterioration in quality of life. Headache is the painful, incapacitating manifestation of a limited number of primary headache disorders, namely migraine, tension headache and facial vascular angina. Con flota propia y una planta automatizada de 7.000 m², ubicada en el corazón de la ciudad, abastecemos diariamente a 7 provincias: Buenos Aires, La Pampa, Neuquén, Río Negro, Chubut, Santa Cruz y Tierra del Fuego. Contamos con un staff de más de 200 colaboradores que hacen posible que, cada día, más de 100 clientes activos de la droguería reciban sus pedidos. Con la misión de brindar un servicio diferente y perfeccionado, distribuimos mensualmente más de 2.000.000 de unidades, recorriendo aproximadamente 163.000 kilómetros, lo que equivale a 5 vueltas al mundo. Integralidad: Comercializamos todos los productos existentes en el mercado, ya sean ambulatorios, OTC, tratamientos especiales, oncología, perfumería, accesorios, etc. Identificación con las marcas y comercialización legítima: Comercializamos productos de laboratorios de reconocidas marcas existentes en el mercado, garantizando la autenticidad por adquirirlos exclusivamente de su productor original. https://www.tamro.fi.text: Tamro - Suomen johtava lääkkeiden ja terveystuotteiden jakelija ja terveysalan palveluntarjoaja | Tamro Hyppää pääsisältöön EN FI Header links MyTamro Main navigation Miksi Tamro Johtavat palvelut lääkkeiden ja terveystuotteiden jakeluun Tarjoamme palveluita apteekeille, sairaaloille, lääke- ja terveystuoteyrityksille, päivittäistavarakaupoille, terveyden ja hyvinvoinnin erikoiskaupoille sekä kotihoidon palveluntarjoajille. Yhdessä lääke- ja terveysalaa kehittämässä Koko terveys- ja hyvinvointiala on ulottuvillasi kauttamme: yhdistämme terveyden arvoketjun eri toimijat. Rakennamme jatkuvasti ymmärrystä alasta ja sen tarjoamista mahdollisuuksista. Suomalaisten parhaaksi ja yhteiskunnan hyödyksi Meillä on tärkeä rooli suomalaisessa yhteiskunnassa, sillä turvaamme terveydenhuoltoa ja hoitoa. Toimimme aina potilaan parhaaksi. Palvelut Lääke- ja terveystuoteyrityksille Toimimme asiakkaidemme kumppanina ja tarjoamme kattavat palvelut markkinoille tulosta tosielämän tutkimukseen ja BI-palveluihin. Jakelu ja varastointi Huolehdimme lääke- ja terveystuotteiden logistiikasta asiantuntevasti ja vastuullisesti. Varmistamme, että oikea tuote on oikeaan aikaan oikeassa paikassa - säilytettynä ja kuljetettuna oikeissa olosuhteissa. Markkinoille tulo Autamme lääkeyrityksiä menestymään Suomen markkinoilla oli sitten kyseessä uuden tuotteen lanseeraus tai siiryminen uudelle terapia-alueelle. Tiedon avulla fiksumpia päätöksiä koko lääkkeen elinkaaren ajan. Myynti ja markkinointi Tuemme terveys- ja hyvinvointituotteiden menestymistä apteekeissa. Tarjoamme kokonaisvaltaisia ratkaisuja myyntiin ja markkinointiin sekä kanavia terveydenhuollon ammattilaisten tavoittamiseen. Tiedolla johtaminen Tarjoamme monipuolista, ajankohtaista ja visuaalista tietoa lääke-ja terveystuoteyritysten päivittäisen liiketoiminnan tarpeisiin sekä päätöksenteon tueksi. Apteekeille ja sairaaloille Kattavat asiantuntija- ja digipalvelut apteekkitoiminnan tueksi Tilaukset, toimitukset ja saatavuus Huolehdimme siitä, että apteekit saavat tarvitsemansa lääkkeet nopeasti ja luotettavasti sekä toimitamme apteekeille kuluttajien arvostamia terveys- ja hyvinvointituotteita. Uuden apteekin perustaminen Uuden apteekkarin aloittaessa eteen tulee monia ratkottavia asioita aina tilausten laskutuksesta valikoiman suunnitteluun ja sidosryhmäyhteistyön luomiseen lähialueella. Apteekin arjen kumppanina Tamro on tukenasi myös apteekin muutostilanteissa. Apteekkimyynnin tuki Asiantuntijamme ja apteekkiedustajamme auttavat apteekkeja onnistumaan ja menestymään. Tarjoamme monenlaisia palveluita ja alueellista koulutusta. Sairaala-apteekeille ja lääkekeskuksille Varmistamme lääkkeiden ja terveystuotteiden jakelun sairaaloille ja lääkekeskuksille. Neuvomme asiantuntijoita saatavuushaasteissa ja korvaavien erityisluvallisten lääkevalmisteiden hankinnassa. MyTamro MyTamro on moderni digitaalisen asioinnin kanava apteekeille, sairaaloille, luontaistuotekaupoille, lääke- ja terveystuoteyrityksille ja muille terveysalan toimijoille. MyTamro eLearning MyTamro eLearning verkkokoulutuspalvelu apteekkilaisille on avoinna 24/7. Tarjolla on monipuolinen valikoima koulutuksia, joiden teemat ja sisällöt nivoutuvat apteekin arkityöhön. Terveydenhuollon toimijoille Turvaamme potilastyötä varmistamalla lääkkeiden saatavuuden sairaala-apteekeissa ja lääkekeskuksissa. Tarjoamme ratkaisuja myös kotihoivaan sekä annosjakeluun. Smila-hoivapalvelu Smila-hoivapalvelu yhdistää itsenäisesti kotona tai hoivakodissa asuvat asiakkaat hoitoyksikköön ja mahdollistaa asiakkaalle turvallisen arjen kotona, mahdollisimman pitkään. Terveydenhuollon toimijoille Kattavat asiantuntija- ja digipalvelut eläinlääkäreille, optikoille, hammaslääkäreille ja yksityisille lääkäriasemille Kuluttajille Tarjoamme terveyttä tukevia palveluita kuluttajille tytär- ja yhteisyritystemme Pharmacin ja Medaffconin kautta. Why does it take so long to get authorization approval from my insurance company? Depending on your plan with your insurance provider, you may or may not require a prior authorization for your DME supplies. Insurance plans have different guidelines on how quickly their clinical teams review the prior authorization requests. It typically ranges anywhere from 1-15 business days depending on your insurance provider. For more information, please contact your insurance provider. Will CGM be covered by Medicaid? Continuous glucose monitors supplies (CGMs) are covered through most State Medicaid Managed Medicaid plans that US MED is contracted with. To find out if US MED is contracted with your insurance provider, please click here and submit your information for our friendly agents to contact you. You can also call 1-877-840-8218. Will my insurance cover all costs for CGM? How much will insurance cover? Benefit coverage on your CGM varies based on your individual plan. US MED will contact your insurance provider to obtain all your coverage details including any out-of-pocket responsibilities you may have. In vitro diagnosis can detect diseases or other conditions and can be used to monitor the overall health of a person for the purpose of healing or treating diseases and preventing them. Early detection of such diseases enable initiating of suitable interventions to prevent concerning conditions in the long run. Nasze rozwiązania telemedyczne (aplikacja i program) sprawiają, że regularne monitorowanie choroby jest łatwiejsze, a wyniki pomiarów m.in z glukometru, ciśnieniomierza, czy termometru są zawsze w zasięgu ręki. Increased Profits Business Efficiency Business Growth Shaping the Future Products Home About Us Careers Events Contact 90th Anniversary Already a Member? Join Now Increased Profits Business Efficiency Value Operational Solutions Pharmacy Operational Solutions Business Growth Unique/ Proprietary Leading Edge Programs Promotional Quality Enhancements Compliance Growth/Restructuring Shaping the Future Value PAC Products Product Listing Contract Administration Proprietary/Unique Product Purchasing Opportunities Office Supply Program Search About Us Our Mission: To facilitate the success of independent pharmacy, allowing for optimum patient care in the community and long-term care environments. While the pharmacy environment has changed considerably since the day we opened our doors in 1934, our dedication to independent pharmacy has remained the same. Established and led by independent pharmacists, Value Drug is committed to providing transparency in our pricing and optimizing manufacturer relationships and purchasing power to improve buying conditions for our members. With the ever-changing and competitive market conditions that exist today, choose the wholesaler that can help you meet the challenges facing independent pharmacy and provide innovative, valuable programs and services to increase your pharmacy’s growth and prosperity. A pharmacy is no longer just a place to get prescriptions filled. Over time, the pharmacy has evolved from an apothecary to a one-stop healthcare destination offering clinical services and convenience items that meet the needs of patients and customers. Value Drug realizes that as the needs of consumers change, so too do the needs of independent pharmacy owners. As competition increases and network access decreases, as reimbursements shrink and regulations expand, you need more than just a wholesaler—you need a partner. At Value Drug, we understand the regulatory issues and marketplace challenges that independent pharmacists must contend with each day. We’ve assembled a diverse portfolio of programs and services that satisfy both the customer’s need for convenience and low-cost healthcare and the pharmacist’s need to increase growth, efficiency and profitability. Join Value Drug today. History Value Drug Company was formed in 1934 as a cooperative of 19 independent pharmacists in Altoona, PA to consolidate their purchasing power. What started as a small business with a staff of five serving local customers from a 1,000 square-foot building has grown into a sophisticated company with a leading edge 205,000 square-foot distribution center. Our state-of-the-art technology has enabled us to achieve greater efficiencies and expand geographically. No longer known solely as a pharmaceutical wholesaler, today Value Drug also provides retail and specialty pharmacy services, long-term care pharmacy support, immunization service offerings, 340B authorized distribution, telemedicine opportunities, and many other clinical service programs. We developed these programs to help offset shrinking reimbursements, keep you competitive and increase your profitability. In 2011, Value Drug established Value Specialty Pharmacy (VSP) to provide independent pharmacies with an option to send specialty prescriptions for fulfillment without utilizing traditional PBM owned mail order facilities. Dually accredited by both URAC and ACHC, VSP is a preferred referral option for patients requiring complex medications for chronic illnesses. We also offer the support services to allow some specialty products to be filled at retail. CP Specialty Pharmacy Services™ was developed in 2016 to enable community pharmacies to dispense specialty medications at their pharmacy. Core Values At Value Drug, the way we conduct business extends beyond just technical competencies to encompass and benefit both our members and business partners. To us, core values hold more meaning than a mere list of words posted on a website. We hire and evaluate team members according to our core values, and we ensure that the actions we take every day reflect the values we’ve established. Customer-Focused We keep our customers’ best interests at the forefront through every action and decision that we make. Results-Oriented We strive to develop innovative ideas, embrace challenges and stop at nothing to get it done in the best way possible. Integrity We do what is ethically right and are transparent in all that we say and do. Teamwork We are dedicated to working together to build a positive culture, accomplish our goals and ensure our customers and business partners succeed. Employee-Focused We keep employees’ health, safety and well-being top-of-mind and help each person achieve their personal and professional goals.
